name: Himekawa Shinobu
source:
Suzuka's attendant and closest friend.

After her parents died as victims of burglary, she was brought to Kuzuryuu household by Kotaro's father. Since then she became Suzuka's closest aide and almost a sister. Refined and composed, she helps Kotaro in his work hoping that one day she will be able to avenge her parents.
